text: わしの　やったポケモンは…ほう　だいぶ　なついた　みたいだな？

structure.jp: わしの　やったポケモンは…
だいぶ　なついた　みたいだな？
structure.en: it seems to have got quite attached, hasn't it?

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: わしの　やったポケモン
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. Inside such a phrase の can stand in for が, so わしの is 'I'. わしのやったポケモン = 'the Pokémon I gave'.

patterns.name: 〜みたいだ
patterns.span: なついた　みたいだ
patterns.explanation: みたいだ after a verb says 'it looks like', a guess from what you can see. なついたみたいだ = 'it seems to have grown attached'.

patterns.name: 〜な (confirmation)
patterns.explanation: な at the end asks the listener to agree, like ね but in an older man's voice. みたいだな = 'seems so, doesn't it?'
